name: 988 Suicide and Crisis Lifeline
what_it_is: 24/7 crisis line that also takes calls from worried family members

name: Crisis Center Birmingham
what_it_is: Local 988 crisis center for the Birmingham area and home of the Recovery Resource Center

name: JBS Mental Health Authority
what_it_is: Community mental health authority for Jefferson Blount and St. Clair counties with a crisis center and a Jefferson County Probate Court program

name: 211 Connects Alabama
what_it_is: Free 24/7 statewide referral line for food housing health care and more
how_to_reach: Dial 2-1-1 or text your ZIP to 898-211

name: FindTreatment.gov
what_it_is: Federal locator for licensed mental health and substance use treatment including programs for both together

name: Alabama Department of Mental Health
what_it_is: State authority over public mental health and substance use services in Alabama

name: One Roof
what_it_is: Coordinated Entry lead for the greater Birmingham area and the front door to shelter and housing help

name: NAMI Alabama
what_it_is: Family education and support groups for mental illness including support for families whose person refuses help

name: Alabama Medicaid
what_it_is: State health coverage. Alabama did not expand Medicaid so most single adults qualify only through disability or as a very-low-income parent. File the disability claim first and Medicaid can follow
how_to_reach: Check the qualifying categories on the site before applying

name: Legal Services Alabama
what_it_is: Free civil legal help including eviction defense and benefits appeals

name: Social Security disability
what_it_is: SSI and SSDI income for people whose conditions keep them from working. Decisions take months so start now

name: Alabama DHR Food Assistance
what_it_is: Food assistance through SNAP once called Food Stamps run by the Alabama Department of Human Resources

name: HUD rental assistance
what_it_is: Federal rental help including public housing and Housing Choice Vouchers through local housing agencies. Waiting lists open and close so ask your housing agency which lists are open now
how_to_reach: Find your local housing agency through the site
